# Master Mind Abacus Odisha

> Master Mind Abacus Odisha is an educational website focused on abacus-based learning and related mental-mathematics education in Odisha. This file provides a concise machine-readable overview of the website and its primary domain.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/): Official website of Master Mind Abacus Odisha.

## Organization

- **Name:** Master Mind Abacus Odisha
- **Website:** https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/
- **Primary focus:** Abacus education and mental-mathematics learning.
- **Geographic focus:** Odisha, India.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/): Official website of Master Mind Abacus Odisha featuring course overviews, interactive calculator, video demonstrations, student awards, and free assessment booking.
- [Blogs](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/blogs.html): Insights, teaching methodologies, and parent guides on mental arithmetic and child cognitive development.
- [Why Early Math Skills Matter](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/blog-single.html): In-depth article exploring the significance of early number sense and how abacus training builds arithmetic confidence.

## Key Sections & Offerings

- [What Is Abacus](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/#what-is-abacus): Overview of the Soroban abacus technique and its impact on speed, memory, and concentration.
- [Programme](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/#programme): Structured curriculum levels (Foundation, Intermediate, Advanced) designed for children aged 5 to 14 years.
- [Our Locations / Franchise Network](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/#franchise-network): Center locations across Odisha (Cuttack, Bhubaneswar, Khurda) and franchise partnership opportunities.
- [Free Assessment Booking](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/#book): 30-minute 1-on-1 diagnostic session to determine a child's learning stage without obligation.
- [FAQ](https://mastermindabacusodisha.com/#faq): Answers to common parent inquiries regarding the 12-student batch limit, commencement age, and timelines for visible results.
